thag6.1:1.1: Pañcanipāto. CHANIPĀTO. Disvāna pāṭihīrāni Gotamassa yasassino na tāvāhaṃ paṇipatiṃ issāmānena vañcito. || ||
thag6.1:2.1: mama saṃkappam aññāya codesi narasārathi, tato me āsi saṃvego abbhuto lomahaṃsano. || ||
thag6.1:3.1: pubbe jaṭilabhūtassa yā me iddhi parittikā, tāhaṃ tadā niraṃkatvā pabbajiṃ jinasāsane. || ||
thag6.1:4.1: pubbe yaññena santuṭṭho kāmadhātupurakkhato, pacchā rāgañ ca dosañ ca mohañ cāpi samūhaniṃ. || ||
thag6.1:5.1: pubbenivāsaṃ jānāmi, dibbacakkhuṃ visodhitaṃ, iddhimā paracittaññū dibbasotañ ca pāpuṇiṃ. || ||
thag6.1:6.1: yassa c' atthāya pabbajito agārasmā anagāriyaṃ, so me attho anuppatto sabbasaṃyojanakkhayo 'ti. || || Uruveḷakassapo thero.
